description: Implementation of the f1u_bearer_impl class handling F1-U bearer logic, including PDU handling, SDU processing, discard management, and timer operations.

classes.name: f1u_bearer_impl
classes.description: Class implementing F1-U bearer logic, managing PDU/SDU processing, timers, and notifications.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles incoming UL messages, pushing to queue or dropping.

methods.name: handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Processes UL messages, including T-PDU and data delivery status, with notifications.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles SDU reception, attaching to message, setting retransmission flag, and notifying.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Queues SDU for discard, manages discard blocks, and triggers backoff timer.

methods.name: fill_discard_blocks
methods.description: Attaches discard blocks to message if any.

methods.name: on_expired_dl_notif_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of DL notification timer, flushing discard blocks.

methods.name: flush_discard_blocks
methods.description: Sends accumulated discard blocks as a PDU.
